name: Lower-third — Syntax house card
description: Reference lower-third on the standard (flat card) variant, recomposed 2026-07-09 for the quality arc calibrate-the-bar pass against the REAL Syntax house style (github.com/randyrektor/syntax-overlay): flat #141413 card, visible #454441 border, rounded corners, the signature chunky stepped hard-offset shadow, Space Grotesk display + Space Mono label, muted #c9c6bc byline. The earlier cinematic dress (scrim gradient + WGSL anamorphic flare) read as glossy generic-template chrome and was retired for this pack — the flare pass now gates on the lower-third.light Pack claim.
